title: 第五章 我又穿越了第六章 穿越后的人牲
lines: 无边黑暗，高台伫立。
看着眼前的巍峨书册，王平心中百感交集：“合着我的金手指要等死了才能激活，也不给我点提示。”
早提醒我，我不早死了？
不过很快，他就露出了狂喜之色。
毕竟这世道，不开挂穿什么越？比起感怀，还是先查看金手指更重要一点，这才是安身立命的本钱。
王平缓步向前，目光落在眼前书页的字迹上，随后就再也移不开了，大量的讯息被强制性灌入脑海。
这是一次无比奇妙的体验，灌入脑海的讯息被自动整合，归类，仿佛这些知识和情报对他而言并不陌生，早在很久很久以前就已经掌握，只是被迫遗忘了，如今也不过是将其重新回忆了起来。
片刻后，王平双手撑地，大口喘息，汗水一滴滴从额头滚落，剧烈的情绪和记忆让他觉得头疼欲裂。
不过拜其所赐，他想起来了。
此地乃是【太平经】的内部空间，说得之间点就是太平间，非常适合他这个某种意义上的“死人”。
简而言之，这本经书的能力是结算，当持有者亲身经历了一场包含了人心，气运，民望的【事件】时，可以用这本经书收容【事件主角】的尸体，将其化作可用的【经卷】，加持持有者自身。
例如眼下的【卷一：域外天魔】。
“以我的穿越作为【事件】，继而转化出了【域外天魔】这道经卷.....这是我把穿越前的尸体给吞了？”
由此结算出来的经卷效果也极好。
“死后复活一次，冷却时间七天，还可以选择不同的世界.....这么说它其实就是我穿越的罪魁祸首？”
王平心有所悟。
从效果来看，自己或许是在地球就得到了这个金手指，死后随机穿越，这才来到了大顺这个破地方。
王平瞬间激动了。
穿越至今二十年，庸碌无为了半辈子，没有人比他更清楚，所谓的穿越之后必成大器完全就是扯淡。
你在地球都没能混出头，凭什么穿越了就能起飞？
要是能回去，谁愿意留在这个破地方。
虽然如今迟来的外挂终于激活，能让自己死后复活，但这个冷却时间却让复活的含金量下降了不少。
“七天？黄花菜都凉了！”
“而且一次怎么够用，一百次还差不多，如果复活后能回溯时间的话就更好了......操作空间大得多。”
“就算没有这个，给我来个加号也行啊。”
王平吐槽了好一会儿，目光直勾勾地落在眼前的【太平经】上，逐字逐句阅读【域外天魔】的经卷。
“.....没有地球啊。”王平长叹一声。
在【域外天魔】的机制里，地球似乎并不算是“他去过的世界”，所以他眼下的选择其实非常有限。
“只能赌一把，随机穿越到新世界了。”
想到这里，王平脸色有些难看：“运气好，我能穿越到一个安全的世界，苟过七天，等到冷却结束。”
运气差，直接落到什么灾区战场，那就落地成盒了。
将性命托付给运气，王平很讨厌这点。
当然，还有另一个选择，那就是复活之后留在大顺王朝，然而这样就衍生出了一个无法避免的问题：
“我才刚死，天知道这个复活机制是怎么复活的？要是原地复活，岂不正好撞上杀了我的那批官兵？”
王平长出一口气，最后咬着牙走到了巍峨书册的面前，看向【卷一：域外天魔】，上面是两行字迹：
【凿破鸿蒙，开祖窍以通玄牝】
【光生虚室，走此门可入洞天】
金光熠熠，龙章凤篆般的文字就这样左右排列开，最后化作一方巍峨门户，仿佛在邀请他步入其中。
content_en:
In the boundless darkness, the high platform stands.
Looking at the majestic book in front of him, Wang Ping had mixed feelings in his heart: "I have to wait until death to activate my golden finger, and you won't give me any hints."
If you had reminded me earlier, wouldn’t I have died earlier?
But soon, he showed a look of ecstasy.
After all, in this world, what's the point of getting through if you don't cheat? Rather than expressing feelings, it is more important to check the golden finger first. This is the capital of settling down.
"Let me see..."
Wang Ping stepped forward slowly, his eyes fell on the writing on the page in front of him, and then he could no longer look away. A large amount of information was forcefully poured into his mind.
This was an extremely wonderful experience. The information poured into his mind was automatically integrated and classified, as if this knowledge and information were no stranger to him. He had mastered it a long time ago, but was forced to forget it. Now he is just recalling it.
"Huh...haaah!"
After a while, Wang Ping put his hands on the ground and gasped for breath. Sweat rolled down his forehead drop by drop. The intense emotions and memories gave him a splitting headache.
But thanks to him, he remembered.
This place is the inner space of the "Taiping Jing". The middle point is the mortuary, which is very suitable for him, a "dead person" in a certain sense.
In short, the ability of this scripture is to settle accounts. When the holder personally experiences an [event] that includes people's hearts, luck, and popularity, this scripture can be used to contain the body of the [protagonist of the event] and turn it into a usable [script] to bless the holder himself.
For example, the current [Volume 1: Extraterrestrial Demon].
"Using my time-travel as an [event], and then transformed into the [Outer Territory Demon] scripture... Is this because I swallowed the body before the time-travel?"
The effect of the scriptures calculated from this is also very good.
"You can be resurrected once after death. The cooling time is seven days. You can also choose different worlds... So it means it is actually the culprit of my time traveling?"
Wang Ping realized something.
Judging from the effect, I might have gotten this golden finger on Earth, and randomly traveled through time after death, and then I came to this broken place called Dashun.
Wang Ping was instantly excited.
He has traveled through time for twenty years and has been mediocre for half his life. No one knows better than him that the so-called saying that someone will become something great after traveling through time is completely nonsense.
You can't make it on Earth, so why can you take off after traveling through time?
If they could go back, who would want to stay in this miserable place.
Although the belated plug-in is finally activated and can resurrect oneself after death, the cooldown time has reduced the value of resurrection a lot.
"Seven days? The day lilies are already cold!"
"And one time is not enough. A hundred times is about the same. It would be better if you could go back in time after resurrection... There is much more room for operation."
"Even if you don't have this, just give me a plus sign."
Wang Ping complained for a long time, his eyes fell directly on the [Taiping Sutra] in front of him, and he read the scripture of [The Demon from Outside the Territory] word by word.
"...There is no earth." Wang Ping sighed.
In the mechanism of [Outer Territory Demon], the earth does not seem to be "the world he has been to", so his current choices are actually very limited.
"I can only take a gamble and randomly travel to a new world."
Thinking of this, Wang Ping's face became a little ugly: "With luck, I can travel to a safe world and survive for seven days until the cooldown is over."
If you are unlucky and fall directly onto a battlefield in a disaster area, you will end up in a box.
Wang Ping hates leaving his life to luck.
Of course, there is another option, which is to stay in the Dashun Dynasty after resurrection. However, this creates an unavoidable problem:
"I just died. God knows how this resurrection mechanism is used to revive me? If I were resurrected on the same spot, wouldn't I just bump into the officers and soldiers who killed me?"
"Huh..."
Wang Ping let out a long breath, and finally gritted his teeth and walked to the majestic book. He looked at [Volume 1: Demons from Outside the Territory]. There were two lines of writing on it:
[Break through the Hongmeng and open the ancestral orifice to gain access to the mysteries]
[Light creates a void, and you can enter the cave through this door]
The golden light shone, and the words like dragon seals and phoenix seals were arranged left and right, and finally turned into a majestic portal, as if inviting him to step into it.
"....Oh shit."
title_en: Chapter 5: I traveled through time again Chapter 6: Human sacrifice after time-traveling
